headline: Refreshes the vendored framework and raises the Node.js floor to 24.18.0
summary: A maintenance release. It refreshes the vendored cryptography and networking framework to its current release — picking up its hardening for WebSocket, HTTP, JSON, path, and regex handling — raises the minimum Node.js runtime to 24.18.0, and keeps the self-update flow working under the framework's stricter release-asset pattern check. No configuration changes are required.

items.title: Refreshed the vendored cryptography and networking framework
items.body: The vendored framework the client is built on was updated to its current release. The refresh brings its security hardening for the outbound WebSocket client, HTTP responses, size- and depth-capped JSON parsing, path-traversal-safe file resolution, and regular-expression safety — the primitives the client relies on when talking to a server.

items.title: Minimum Node.js runtime raised to 24.18.0
items.body: The runtime floor is now Node.js 24.18.0 (24.17.0 was a security release; 24.18.0 bundles SQLite 3.53.1 and a backup-path fix). Prebuilt binaries embed a matching runtime; only from-source installs need to act.

items.title: Self-update keeps working under the framework's stricter asset-pattern check
items.body: The framework now runs the release-asset match pattern through its ReDoS-safe regular-expression sanitizer. The pattern that selects this platform's binary and signature is now expressed as a bounded character class rather than an optional group with an inner quantifier — a shape the sanitizer refuses. Without this change the refreshed framework would have rejected the pattern and silently disabled self-update; stable, prerelease, and build-metadata release names all continue to match, and the wrong-platform and ML-DSA sidecar assets are still excluded.

items.title: Run Node.js 24.18.0 or newer for from-source installs
items.body: Upgrade the runtime to Node.js 24.18.0+ before running the client from a source checkout. Prebuilt binary releases embed their own runtime and need no action.
